Definition: from G3645; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent:--destroyer.
BiblicalUsage: Olothreutes is the destroyer, the ruiner, by special use the serpent. Paul uses it once, in 1 Corinthians 10:10, warning not to murmur as some murmured and were destroyed of the destroyer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe murmuring invites the destroyer, and the wilderness proves that a complaining people destroys itself.
